name: fluctseed
description: Spec-driven and empirical AI engineering lifecycle across setup, brainstorm, new-track, implement, review, status, and revert.

interface.shortDescription: Spec-driven lifecycle with zero-context design audits and empirical execution rigor
interface.longDescription: Provides a stateful track lifecycle (setup, brainstorm, new-track, implement, review, status, revert) with zero-context subagent design verification, Stage 3 Human Gate locking, and empirical implementation, root-cause debugging, and verification discipline.
capabilities: Project initialization and directory architecture contracts (setup)
Specification drafting and zero-context subagent cross-verification (new-track)
Disciplined implementation with playbooks, behavioral TDD, and decision trails (implement)
Runtime verification, spec-to-code drift checks, code review, and PR creation (review)
Multi-module monorepo progress and gate status dashboard (status)
Git-reconciled rollback with append-only audit trail preservation (revert)
defaultPrompt: Initialize this repository with project context and directory architecture contracts.
Stress-test a new feature concept across 7 fresh-context lenses.
Plan a new feature and verify it with fresh-context reviewers.
Execute the approved track plan under empirical engineering discipline.
